mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% is followed by positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the correlation between CPIAUCSL YoY and 20-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) indicates strengthening consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS 3-month growth > 0% is followed by negative 60-day forward returns in > 40% of instances, or if the correlation between RSAFS growth and 60-day forward returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which leads to wage inflation and increased production costs, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 4% is followed by positive 5-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the correlation between UNRATE and 5-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 2% month-over-month signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO MoM < -2% is followed by positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the correlation between INDPRO MoM and 20-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the Housing Starts (HOUST) increase by more than 5% month-over-month and Real Final Sales (RSAFS) also increase, it signals a strong demand environment, boosting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the joint condition (HOUST MoM > 5% and RSAFS MoM > 0%) is followed by negative 60-day forward returns in > 40% of instances, or if the joint correlation is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) increase of more than 0.25% in a single month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS MoM > 0.25% is followed by positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the correlation between FEDFUNDS MoM and 20-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 in a month signals strong labor market conditions, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS MoM > 200,000 is followed by negative 5-day forward returns in > 40% of instances, or if the correlation between PAYEMS MoM and 5-day forward returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of GDP growth (GDPC1) above 2% quarter-over-quarter, an increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) by more than 5% month-over-month signals robust demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the joint condition (GDP growth > 2% QoQ and HOUST MoM > 5%) is followed by negative 20-day forward returns in > 40% of instances, or if the joint correlation is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).
